title: Better Pumpkin Blur
description: remove the blur when you put on a pumpkin.
body:
# 🎃 Better Pumpkin Blur

✨ See clearly while wearing a pumpkin!

**Better Pumpkin Blur** is a simple texture pack that removes the blur overlay when wearing a carved pumpkin, giving you a clear and unobstructed view.

---

## 🔍 Features
- 👁️ Removes pumpkin blur overlay  
- 🎯 Clear vision while wearing a pumpkin  
- ⚡ Lightweight & performance-friendly  
- 🎨 Vanilla-friendly design  

---

## 📦 Why use it?
Wearing a pumpkin can be useful, but the blur makes it annoying. This pack lets you keep the functionality without sacrificing visibility.

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility
✔ Works with most versions  
✔ Can be combined with other texture packs  

---

💡 Small tweak, big comfort.
